title: Former Fire Chief's Vigilante Novel Gains Traction
seoTitle: Former Fire Chief's Vigilante Novel Gains Traction
subtitle: David Wickenden Releases Third Volume in Series Featuring Heroine Laura Lamour in Nigeria
excerpt: David Wickenden, former Sudbury fire chief, publishes Toy Soldiers, the third book in his vigilante series, sending the protagonist on a mission in Nigeria.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The release of Toy Soldiers, the third title in the vigilante series written by David Wickenden, has generated intense online searches. The novel places heroine Laura Lamour on a delicate mission in Nigeria, attracting readers interested in action plots and justice outside the bounds of the law.

What Brings Laura Lamour to Nigeria

In the new work, the vigilante is called upon to locate and negotiate the release of a Canadian diplomat captured by Nigerian insurgents. The setting expands the character's journey, who had previously traveled through Canada and Paris in earlier volumes.

How Firefighting Experience Influences the Narrative

Wickenden, who served as deputy chief of Greater Sudbury Fire Services, uses his knowledge of firefighting to shape the figure of Laura Lamour, presenting her as someone determined to ensure justice when the judicial system fails.

Real Inspirations Behind the Plot

The author mentions readings about child soldiers and autobiographies of young combatants in Sierra Leone as sources that helped compose the story's background. He describes how the horrors experienced by children in armed conflicts influence the vigilante's motivation.

Wickenden's Writing Process

After eight books, Wickenden admits that writing doesn't get easier, but new ideas emerge. He defines himself as a “pantser,” comparing himself to writer Stephen King for writing “by the seat of his pants,” unlike authors who plan every detail before starting.

Advice for New Writers

The vice-president of the Crime Writers of Canada recommends that aspiring authors sit down and write, without waiting for a perfect text. For him, writing is a marathon and should be approached as a continuous process.

What to Expect from the Series

Readers can anticipate that, as in previous books, Laura Lamour will face global challenges, pursuing criminals while evading authorities. The combination of action, international travel, and humanitarian issues keeps the series in focus among crime fiction fans.

With information from CTV News.
